narr: Deep monsoonal moisture was located across much of New Mexico with an upper trough approaching the Four Corners region. This helped storms to develop overnight and brought heavy rain to portions of the White Sands Missile Range west of Tularosa.
ev: White Sands Missile Range personnel reported flooding around the intersection of Range Route 6 and 9 with roads impassable in places.
lsr: Intersection of Range Road Route 6 and 9 had water flowing over the road and was impassable.
